progression_rule: a stage is exposed only after an authentic win on its immediate predecessor

frontier_freeze.reason: demo boundary requested after fresh ordered-prefix revalidation; 3-1 and later work is paused

ordered_prefix_validation.evaluation_mode: stochastic frozen stage-specialist router with per-episode policy reseeding
ordered_prefix_validation.pre_schema_fix_note: Terminal outcomes, seeds, returns, lengths, and attempts are valid; the report divided win_rate by the attempt ceiling instead of attempts actually executed in until-win mode.

fresh_revalidation.runner_semantics: one ordered stage-specialist router invocation; each authentic terminal win exposes the immediate next level; an engine process is reset between attempts and stages

legacy_composite_es_2x4_superseded.reason: used manually weighted win, return, and truncation statistics; future ES uses mean environment return only

2-5.selection_objective: highest exact heldout mean environment return

vector_click_alignment.interpretation: same-cell zombie state is strongly predictive and a 3x3 learned receptive field covers almost every positive click

mower_robustness.method: matched environment seeds and per-episode stochastic-policy reseeding; normal engine versus all mowers removed at reset
mower_robustness.interpretation: Mowers provide a measurable safety net, but the policy remains independently capable: 65% win rate with no mowers and three of four mower-triggered normal seeds also win in the disabled condition.

robustness_branch.method: REINFORCE fine-tuning in the exact no-mower engine without reward shaping
robustness_branch.interpretation: The no-mower fine-tune overfit its training seeds and is rejected; retain the frozen predecessor, which achieved 13/20 under the matched no-mower audit.

go_explore_factored_trace_branch_novelty.method: resume the preserved branch-novelty archive while retaining the set of semantic action branches seen during the preceding 64 decisions

clean_vdn_autoregressive_ppo.method: clean-start VDN-PPO control with autoregressive actor and behavior-centered branching critic
clean_vdn_autoregressive_ppo.acceptance: fresh full 3-1 terminal win from an original reset

ordered_loadout_map_elites_v1.method: MAP-Elites over authentic unique ordered seed-packet loadouts with a frozen learned controller
ordered_loadout_map_elites_v1.interpretation: Frozen-controller loadout ranking is itself myopic: the best short-return loadout omits Lily Pad. Preserve the QD archive and co-adapt a loadout-conditioned controller before reranking.
ordered_loadout_map_elites_v1.acceptance: fresh full 3-1 terminal win from an original reset

loadout_curriculum_vdn_ppo.method: clean-start VDN-PPO with an episode-level authentic loadout sampled from all MAP-Elites cells and observed through seed-packet identity
loadout_curriculum_vdn_ppo.loadout_sampling: generic per-episode sampling across the complete QD archive
loadout_curriculum_vdn_ppo.acceptance: fresh full 3-1 terminal win from an original reset

ordered_loadout_map_elites_coadapt_v2.method: matched archive-seeded MAP-Elites reranks after packet-identity-conditioned controller adaptation; every prior elite is re-evaluated before mutation
ordered_loadout_map_elites_coadapt_v2.interpretation: The conditioned VDN-PPO controller collapsed to almost pure wait, so every authentic deck maps to one behavior cell and selection is uninformative. Reject this controller and preserve the pre-collapse teacher for the next joint policy/loadout evolutionary test.
ordered_loadout_map_elites_coadapt_v2.acceptance: fresh full 3-1 terminal win from an original reset

teacher_policy_loadout_outcome_es_v1.method: one matched stochastic antithetic outcome-ES policy run per archived authentic ordered loadout, preserving the pre-collapse teacher
teacher_policy_loadout_outcome_es_v1.selection: all seven archive elites; no deck or plant identity hand-selected
teacher_policy_loadout_outcome_es_v1.top_two_selection: indices 6 and 2 by held-out mean authentic environment return only
teacher_policy_loadout_outcome_es_v1.interpretation: Authentic loadout choice changes behavior substantially, including slot coverage and zero-sun placement, but neither the best-return non-Lily deck nor the best diverse Lily deck yields a terminal win. Preserve the interface and reject this outcome-ES controller family at 3-1.
teacher_policy_loadout_outcome_es_v1.acceptance: fresh full 3-1 terminal win from an original reset

goal_conditioned_iql_worker.method: offline goal-conditioned IQL with hindsight relabeling and shared spatial state/goal encoders
goal_conditioned_iql_worker.goal_reward: zero on achieved state and minus one otherwise
goal_conditioned_iql_worker.interpretation: strong in-sample directional reachability separation; not completion evidence and not yet a held-out reachability pass
goal_conditioned_iql_worker.acceptance: held-out subgoal reachability before hierarchical deployment; fresh terminal 3-1 win for campaign promotion

goal_conditioned_iql_heldout_v2.method: goal-conditioned IQL with episode-disjoint training and validation prefixes
goal_conditioned_iql_heldout_v2.acceptance: policy reaches held-out generic archive cells when the recorded continuation remains replayable

goal_iql_frontier_hierarchy_v1.method: fresh-start hierarchical execution toward the deepest generic archive cell inside a competence region fit from held-out engine outcomes
goal_iql_frontier_hierarchy_v1.goal_features: random-projection archive cell and generic action-prefix depth
goal_iql_frontier_hierarchy_v1.competence_calibration: balanced-accuracy threshold over held-out predicted goal values and engine successes
goal_iql_frontier_hierarchy_v1.interpretation: The worker can chain early layers on some fresh seeds, but after failure its held-out-prefix value calibration admits unrelated deeper goals; reject unbounded upward replanning.
goal_iql_frontier_hierarchy_v1.acceptance: fresh terminal 3-1 win; archive depth is diagnostic only

goal_iql_frontier_depth_bounded_v2.method: matched fresh-start hierarchy where a failed option imposes a depth ceiling until an equal-or-shallower alternative succeeds
goal_iql_frontier_depth_bounded_v2.interpretation: Depth ceiling removes upward skipping, but one hierarchy-exhausted episode stopped before an engine terminal and invalidates return aggregation.
goal_iql_frontier_depth_bounded_v2.acceptance: fresh terminal 3-1 win; archive depth is diagnostic only

goal_iql_frontier_depth_bounded_complete.method: matched failure-depth-bounded hierarchy with housekeeping-only completion after goal exhaustion so every return ends at engine terminal or configured cap
goal_iql_frontier_depth_bounded_complete.acceptance: fresh terminal 3-1 win; archive depth is diagnostic only

goal_iql_fresh_layer_collection_v1.method: full fresh-start depth-bounded hierarchy trajectories recorded for hindsight relabeling on the true clean-reset state distribution
goal_iql_fresh_layer_collection_v1.purpose: train the next hindsight-IQL layer; not campaign-completion evidence

goal_iql_layered_fresh_v3.method: warm-started goal-IQL over restored-prefix and full fresh-start trajectories with a source-stratified episode split
goal_iql_layered_fresh_v3.acceptance: improved held-out fresh-source reachability followed by a fresh terminal 3-1 win

goal_iql_layered_frontier_bounded_v4.method: fresh-start failure-depth-bounded hierarchy calibrated only by held-out authentic fresh-source reachability
goal_iql_layered_frontier_bounded_v4.acceptance: fresh terminal 3-1 win; archive depth remains diagnostic only

goal_iql_layered_fresh_corpus_v2.method: raw-row DuckDB merge of the prior source-stratified corpus plus matched argmax and stochastic bounded-hierarchy clean-reset trajectories

goal_iql_layered_fresh_v4.method: warm-started goal-IQL with a source-stratified split over prefix, first-layer, and two bounded second-layer clean-reset sources
goal_iql_layered_fresh_v4.acceptance: held-out reachability on both new clean-reset sources followed by a fresh terminal 3-1 win

goal_iql_layered_frontier_v5.method: failure-depth-bounded fresh-start hierarchy using the latest failure-source goals and both large and small held-out calibration sets
goal_iql_layered_frontier_v5.interpretation: Low-level reachability improved, but restricting high-level candidates to the newest failure source regresses fresh chaining and exhausts every hierarchy. Stop this branch instead of adding another hindsight layer.

pool_world_model_dyna_v1.loadout_protocol: each controller receives its own ordered-loadout MAP-Elites search seeded by the prior complete archive; packet identity is encoded in the controller observation

real_only_dqn.interpretation: The learned outer selector chose a Lily-Pad deck and changed behavior, but plant selection does not rescue this real-only offline controller.

conservative_multistep_ensemble_dyna.purpose: separate useful model augmentation from three-step model-bias amplification

pool_world_model_dyna_v1.promotion_gate: fresh authentic 3-1 terminal win followed by mower-disabled robustness

jepa_cluster_goal_frontier_v1.screen_protocol: all seven learned loadouts on common fresh seeds; no hand-selected pool deck

calibration.method: balanced-accuracy threshold fit jointly from verified-prefix and exact-loadout clean-start sources; the all-success v1 cutoff is not reused

second_layer.interpretation: A second clean-failure replay layer improves restored-goal value separation but regresses fresh control: only the return-leading inherited deck reaches an accepted cluster, at depth 91, and every episode has return -100. Stop replay stacking and learn a worker-specific seed-packet outer policy over the full unlocked set.

learned_episode_start_loadout_policy.algorithm: ordered-loadout MAP-Elites over the complete authentic unlocked plant set, with the loadout treated as an episode-start outer action for a fixed goal worker
learned_episode_start_loadout_policy.fitness: terminal win rate followed by unmodified environment return
learned_episode_start_loadout_policy.interpretation: Start-of-level plant choice is learnable and materially changes return and behavior, including emergence of zero-sun placement without shaping. Neither the broad evolutionary sweeps nor common-seed reranking yields a terminal 3-1 win; loadout choice alone cannot repair the remaining inner-policy exploration failure.

jepa_cluster_goal_frontier_v1.promotion_gate: fresh authentic 3-1 terminal win followed by mower-disabled robustness

uniform_legal_exploration.interpretation: uniform legal sampling spends on cheaper packets before the 100-sun combat packet becomes legal

3-1.selection_objective: highest exact heldout mean environment return after any authentic terminal win

level7_boundary_done_ablation.label_note: trained before collector time limits were separated from environment terminals

level8_terminal_corrected_comparison.terminal_target: environment terminated only; collector truncations remain nonterminal

limitations: The selected level 1-10 checkpoint also solves 2-1 zero-shot, but full regression across every earlier stage has not yet established one checkpoint for the complete prefix.
Reached means the immediate predecessor was won in order; it does not imply a win on the newly exposed frontier.
The original level 1-7 zero-win conclusion was invalid because a 1,200-decision cap truncated healthy episodes before the final wave; corrected 3,600-decision evaluation produces authentic wins.
The learned ensemble improves held-out prediction but its horizon-eight CEM controller has no 1-6 or 1-7 wins.
